TextButton_2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local function addDecals(root)
		for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=134373153398891" then
				v:Destroy() 
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
				local texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=134373153398891"
					
				local One = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				local Two = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				local Three = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				local Four = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				local Five = Instance.new("Decal", v)
				local Six = Instance.new("Decal", v)

				One.Texture = texture
				Two.Texture = texture
				Three.Texture = texture
				Four.Texture = texture
				Five.Texture = texture
				Six.Texture = texture

				One.Face = "Front"
				Two.Face = "Back"
				Three.Face = "Right"
				Four.Face = "Left"
				Five.Face = "Top"
				Six.Face = "Bottom"
			end
			addDecals(v)
		end
	end

	addDecals(game.Workspace)
end)

	local meshId = "rbxassetid://121207878722729"
